description:
With off-road parking and a welcoming front garden, the home immediately makes a warm first impression. Step inside and you’re greeted by a bright, open-plan living room and kitchen, flooded with natural light — the perfect space for relaxing or entertaining. Upstairs, you’ll find a well-proportioned double bedroom complete with ample storage, alongside a family bathroom, with a recently fitted shower as well as boiler.

While the property would benefit from some modernisation, it presents the ideal canvas for anyone eager to put their own stamp on a home, however is perfectly livable as is. The generously sized rear garden, with convenient side access, adds to the appeal — offering fantastic potential for outdoor enjoyment or future enhancement, with the added benefit of newly installed fencing and shed. Positioned on a quiet dead-end street, the home enjoys a sense of privacy while still being within easy reach of local amenities, being just a mile to the city centre, and excellent transport links.

If you're searching for a home with potential in a well-connected yet peaceful location, this could be the perfect opportunity. Ideal for first time buyers & those looking to downsize. Get in touch today to arrange your viewing and start imagining the possibilities.
